title: Pullbacks and reversals
summary: A pullback moves against the trend but keeps its structure. A reversal breaks the structure and builds a new one in the opposite direction.
unreliableWhen: At the time, the two look the same. A broken structure can repair itself. On a higher timeframe, a reversal may be just a pullback.
goodExample: Uptrend with a last higher low at 4,580. Price dips to 4,620 and stays above it: "pullback so far".
badExample: Calling every dip "the top", or calling a clear break below the last higher low "just a pullback" because you hold a trade.

chart.lookFor: Mark the last higher low before the dip. Watch whether the dip stays above it. Then open the Reversal scenario and find the candle that broke the structure.
